title: Gelest, Inc.
content: Gelest, Inc. is a U.S. specialty materials supplier focused on silanes, silicones, metal-organic compounds, and related advanced chemistry products. Its product portfolio is relevant to silica aerogel synthesis, sol-gel processing, and surface modification, where organosilicon precursors and functional additives are commonly used in research and production. Gelest serves both laboratory-scale development and commercial supply needs for materials-intensive innovation programs.
